question_record.context: A security incident related to suspicious remote activity was identified on the machine named `vnevado-win11t`. This incident showed multiple signs of potentially malicious activities such as initiating interactive sessions, modifying files, passing WMI commands, creating scheduled tasks, etc. In this context, suspicious processes were involved, including commands such as `curl http://vectorsandarrows.com`, `vssblatemp.exe delete shadows /all`, and `bcdedit` commands. The attack appears to have involved lateral movement across different devices.
question_record.question: According to the incident details, there was a lateral movement attempt observed. What is the IP address associated with this lateral movement activity?
solution: Suspicious remote activity was detected involving the process `vssblatemp.exe`.
File backups on the host `vnevado-win11u` were deleted using WMI or VSSAdmin, as is common during Ransomware infections.
Possible lateral movement was observed, linked to the IP address `38.142.109.10`.

107.name: Suspicious remote activity
107.description: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed on this machine. This alert can flag attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, and other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine.

121.name: File backups were deleted
121.description:
All file snapshots and shadow copies have been deleted via WMI or VSSAdmin which is common during Ransomware infection.

For more information, read the Activity Profile: Iranian MOIS operators opportunistically deploy limited-impact wiper in response to Israel-Hamas war Threat Analytics report: https://security.microsoft.com/threatanalytics3/c6674205-df28-453a-9e42-0010b7979bdd/overview?tid4b2462a4-bbee-495a-a0e1-f23ae524cc9c

101.name: Possible lateral movement
101.description: Lateral movement on another device was observed in close time proximity to a suspicious network event on this device. This could mean that an attacker is attempting to move laterally across devices to gather data or elevate privileges. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint alert.
